scientific_disclaimer: Oracle routing is an upper-bound/control condition and does not demonstrate that a learned router can recover the same selection policy.

marker_neutrality_control.finding: Router representation of marker alone achieves 33.4% ± 0.2% task-family accuracy (chance: 33.3%). Confirms zero family leakage.

verdict.description: Learned router beats strongest fixed baseline (V2: 67.0%) with 90.5% accuracy (+23.5%) while simultaneously reducing theoretical forward compute from 46,296 to 26,937 FLOPs (-41.8% reduction). Recovers 99.8% of the Phase 7 oracle routing advantage.
verdict.routing_gate_status: OPEN FOR PHASE 8B — learned routing supported, compute-aware routing now justified
verdict.justification: Empirical evidence demonstrates that a minimal learned router (340 parameters) operating strictly on observable permutation-invariant representations discovers sample-level specialization, significantly outperforms all fixed architectures, and recovers nearly all the oracle advantage without task-family metadata.
